Многие предприниматели никогда раньше не заказывали разработку IT-решений. Они привыкли к SaaS-сервисам за 500 ₽ в месяц или конструкторам, где можно собрать что-то базовое за вечер. jobs.title: Python Developer — Fix & Optimize Slot Detection Logic for 3AM Window + All-Day Monitoring ( Barq)
jobs.description:
Please read the project carefully before submitting your proposal.

Python Developer — Fix & Optimize Slot Detection Logic for 3AM Window + All-Day Monitoring (  Barq)

Overview
We have a fully deployed booking system (Barq ) at https://*****ev.dev. The system is live and functional. We need one specific behavioral fix to the slot detection and booking logic.

The Exact Required Behavior (What Must Work):
Phase 1 — Intensive Window: 03:00 to 03:15 Baghdad Time (Daily)
This is the primary booking window. The   server releases slots at 03:00 AM.
Slots may become bookable at any second between 03:00 and 03:15, not necessarily exactly at 03:00.
During this 15-minute window the system must run a precise, high-frequency scan (every 1–3 seconds) calling get_slots + confirming bookability via check-availability.
Priority order for booking:
First: slots for tomorrow (the next calendar day).
Second: any other available days within the current month.
The instant a slot is confirmed bookable → fire the booking POST immediately for all armed transactions targeting that office.
Do NOT wait until 03:00 exactly — start the intensive scan slightly before (e.g. 02:58) and continue until 03:15.
Phase 2 — All-Day Background Monitoring: 03:15 onwards (All Day)

We are a Brazilian water well drilling and maintenance company digitizing our entire operation — and building it as a multi-tenant SaaS from day one, with the goal of later offering the platform to other companies in our industry. We operate in Brasília, Brazil (UTC-3).

## What we are building

A B2B operations platform that sits at the intersection of three product categories:

1. **Field service management** (think ServiceTitan / Jobber, but for water wells): customers, work orders, field crews, equipment, field bulletins, a future offline-first mobile app for technicians.
2. **Contract & progress-measurement billing** (think Procore's commercial flow): versioned proposals, contracts with line items, amendments, field work measured against contract items, approval workflow, invoicing, Brazilian tax documents (NFS-e) and payment reconciliation.

We have a **versioned architecture and data-model baseline (v3.0.0 handoff package)** produced and validated statically. It contains:

We are seeking a dedicated, high-performing 5-person project team (or individual specialists forming a team) to design, build, and deploy an end-to-end B2B Lead Acquisition, Sales Automation, and Internal Workforce Platform.
The software consists of 6 integrated modules covering data extraction, multi-channel client outreach, real-time team messaging, and workforce productivity.

Key Modules & System Scope
Module 1: Data Scraper Pipeline — High-performance B2B directory & active job posting scrapers with anti-bot bypass and proxy management.

Module 5: Proprietary Team Chat App — Standalone cross-platform (Mobile & Desktop) real-time messaging system using WebSockets.
Module 6: Workforce Management — Desktop monitoring agent for screenshot capture, time logging, and app/website activity tracking.

Required Team Roles & Tech Stack
We are hiring for the following 5 distinct roles:
1x Technical Product Manager / Project Lead: Agile sprint management, technical QA testing, code review, and milestone delivery.
1x Senior Data Extraction Engineer: Python, Scrapy, Playwright/Selenium, Proxy Rotation, Cloudflare Bypass.
1x Lead Backend Architect: Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Django Channels (WebSockets), Redis, Celery.
1x Cross-Platform Mobile & Frontend Engineer: React.js (Web Dashboard), Flutter (iOS/Android/Desktop Chat), Electron.js (Desktop Agent).
1x UI/UX Designer: Figma wireframes, component design systems, and responsive layouts.

Project Standards & Architectural Requirements
Modular Monolith Architecture Requirement: The backend must be built using a Modular Monolith architecture in Django. Code Ownership & Security: Daily Git commits forced directly to our company GitHub repository. Developers work with seed/dummy datasets; no raw production keys are exposed.
Deployment Readiness: All completed modules must include Docker containers and fully documented setup guides (README.md).

jobs.title: Senior Solution & Network Architect – Cyber Vault | Long-Term Contract
jobs.description:
I are seeking an experienced Senior Solution & Network Architect to design and support the implementation of an enterprise Cyber Vault and isolated recovery environment for a major organisation in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

This is not a general cloud, DevOps, system administration, or backup-operations role. We require a senior architect who has personally designed secure, isolated, and resilient recovery platforms that protect critical enterprise data against ransomware and major cyber incidents.

The successful consultant will own or contribute significantly to the end-to-end architecture across backup, storage, virtualization, cloud, network isolation, privileged access, secrets management, security controls, and disaster recovery.

Key Responsibilities
Design the end-to-end Cyber Vault and isolated recovery architecture.
Produce HLDs, LLDs, reference architectures, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.
Design immutable, air-gapped, or logically isolated backup repositories.
Define network segmentation between production, backup, Cyber Vault, and clean-recovery environments.
Design secure administrative access, privileged-access controls, break-glass procedures, and four-eyes approval processes.
Define recovery sequencing, RPO, RTO, restoration testing, and ransomware-recovery procedures.
Review existing cloud, data-centre, storage, VMware, backup, and network environments.
Evaluate technologies and vendors through RFI, RFP, POC, or technical-assessment processes.
Present proposed designs to senior stakeholders, Architecture Review Boards, or Design Authorities.
Support technical teams throughout implementation, testing, handover, and operational readiness.
Essential Experience

Applicants should have at least 10 years of enterprise IT experience, with strong architecture experience in several of the following areas:

Cyber Vault or Cyber Recovery architecture
Isolated Recovery Environments
Immutable or air-gapped backup
Ransomware recovery and clean-room restoration
Rubrik, Veeam, Commvault, Cohesity, NetBackup, Dell PowerProtect, Data Domain, Avamar, NetWorker, HYCU, or IBM Spectrum Protect
Enterprise SAN/NAS and object-storage architecture
Fibre Channel, zoning, LUNs, multipathing, storage replication, and retention controls
VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, vSAN, NSX, SRM, or VMware Cloud Foundation
AWS or Microsoft Azure infrastructure, storage, networking, security, and disaster recovery
Cisco or Juniper networking
BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, inter-site connectivity, firewalls, and network segmentation
HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, ARCON, or another enterprise secrets-management or PAM platform
Zero Trust, IAM, RBAC, MFA, encryption, PKI, and HSM integration
ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS, DORA, or other regulated-industry security frameworks
HLD, LLD, target-state architecture, reference architecture, and technical-roadmap preparation

Important Clarification
HashiCorp Vault and Cyber Vault are different technologies.

jobs.title: SEO-Optimized Recruiting Agency Site

jobs.title: AEM Content Updates & Templates

jobs.title: Print-Ready Membership Directory Template
jobs.description:
I’m assembling our non-profit’s next paper membership directory and need a clean, print-ready template I can update with new data each year. I’ll supply the member information as a CSV; what I need from you is the layout itself, delivered both as an editable file (InDesign, Affinity Publisher, or Word—whichever you prefer) and a press-quality PDF I can take straight to the copier.

Scope of pages  
• Cover page: straightforward placement of our logo, the directory title, and publication year—no elaborate graphics, just balanced typography that looks professional when printed in black-and-white or color.  
• Opening section: two short background pages—one for our mission statement and history, another listing the current Board of Directors. Please style these so I can drop in text and swap board names easily.  
• Membership listings: three distinct groupings pulled from the same data file. Each member entry must show Name, full Contact Details, Membership Duration & Status, and the member’s Spouse Name. A clear hierarchy, consistent spacing, and legible fonts are key because many of our members are older and prefer larger type.

Data handling  
Set up the directory so future updates are painless: link the CSV through data-merge or table styles, include field placeholders, and give me a short note explaining how to refresh the data without breaking the layout.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Editable source file + print-ready PDF delivered.  
2. Stylesheets, paragraph/character styles, or table styles clearly labeled.  
3. Sample merge using 5–10 dummy records to confirm fields flow correctly.  
4. All fonts either system-standard or outlined/embedded.

If this sounds like a project you can turn around quickly and neatly, I’m ready to send over the logo, brand colors, and the initial CSV.

jobs.title: Office Photometric Analysis Needed
jobs.description:

Please deliver all native calculation files (AGi32, Dialux, or similar), the final PDF package, and any supporting spreadsheets by end of day August 4 (my time zone is stated in the plan set). jobs.title: SaaS Marketplace & Recruiting Platform

Stripe or a similar PCI-compliant gateway will be integrated for payments, while Elasticsearch (or an equivalent) can power the search layer.

Critical requirements are real-time push notifications (Firebase or AWS SNS are fine) and selectable in-app purchases for premium listing boosts. Offline mode is optional for a later phase, so architecture should keep it in mind but not hold up v1.

Clean REST or GraphQL APIs must connect web and mobile clients. CI/CD, automated tests, and Dockerized deployment to AWS or GCP will be part of the workflow.

Deliverables  
• Full source code in a private repo  
• Staging & production environments configured  
• Web marketplace with reviews, payments, search/filter live  
• Recruiting dashboard with job posting, applicant tracking, résumé DB  
• Cross-platform mobile app with push notifications and in-app purchases  
• Technical documentation and a hand-off walkthrough  

Acceptance Criteria  
1. All listed features function bug-free on modern browsers and latest mobile OS versions.  
2. Payments pass live transactions in sandbox and production.  
3. Deployment scripts reproducibly spin up the entire stack from scratch.

jobs.title: Convert MP3 VU to JSON
jobs.description:
I have a single-track MP3 voice recording that drives a character animation. I need a small utility that scans the file, samples the VU (volume) level at position-noted intervals relative to time, and produces a clean JSON file containing the “cue points” I will use to open or close the character’s mouth.

What I expect the JSON to look like (the first line can remain static):
[
[{"src":"assets/sounds/musicGreeting.ogg","id":"musicStage1","stageSrc":"assets/decoration1.png","stageId":"stage1","cuepoints":[{"position":900,"openSpeed":200,"wide":20,"duration":80,"closeSpeed":150},{"position":1600,"openSpeed":200,"wide":30,"duration":100,"closeSpeed":200},
  ...
]

The exact thresholds that decide between “open” and “close” can be configurable; a simple dB value in a settings block or CLI flag is fine. No frequency analysis or other metadata is required—just volume-based cues at position markers as audio levels change. I will share the online UI interface and/or scripts for clarity on how 'position', 'openSpeed', 'wide', 'duration' and 'closeSpeed' relate. Right now this is a completely manual process I would like to automate.

Please base the solution on common, well-supported libraries—ffmpeg, pydub, Sox, or their Node/Python equivalents—so I can run it on either a Windows PC or in an HTML5 browser without extra licensing headaches.

Deliverables
• Source code (Python or Node.js) with clear comments  
• A short README explaining how to run the script and adjust the threshold  
• Sample output JSON generated from a test MP3 I will supply  

Acceptance criteria
• Running the command against my MP3 produces a JSON array with one entry as vocal level rises and falls 
• Cue values flip correctly when the volume crosses the chosen threshold  
• No external GUI or heavy frameworks—CLI only, quick to integrate into an existing pipeline  

That’s the entire scope; concise, deterministic, and ready for immediate use in my animation workflow.

Calibration guide and testing report

jobs.title: Gold Investment Platform Development
jobs.description:
The project in one sentence

MySikaGold is building the digital equivalent of an investment bank focused on gold, allowing customers to buy, own, monitor, and eventually redeem physical gold through a secure, regulated investment platform.

What problem is MySikaGold solving?

Today, buying investment-grade gold is difficult for most people because it usually requires:

Large amounts of money
Visiting dealers
Trusting physical storage
Manual paperwork
Limited transparency

MySikaGold solves this by allowing someone to invest as little as the minimum investment into professionally managed gold funds through a mobile application while the actual gold is held under regulated custody.

The vision

Think of the platform as combining:

MTN MoMo
Fidelity Mutual Funds
Gold ETF investing
Mobile Banking
Treasury investment
Digital Wallet

into one application.

Instead of buying shares, users buy fractions of real gold.

Who will use the platform?

The RFP shows that this platform serves many different stakeholders—not only investors.

These include:

1. Retail Investors

The main mobile app users.

They should be able to:

Register
Verify identity
Buy gold
View portfolio
Monitor investment growth
Receive statements
Sell gold
Redeem physical gold
2. Diaspora Investors

People outside Ghana should be able to:

Register remotely
Complete international KYC
Pay with cards
Invest in Ghanaian gold
3. African Investors

Investors from other African countries will invest using PAPSS.

4. Fund Managers

They control:

NAV
Pricing
Fund approvals
Investment management
5. Trustees

They independently verify transactions and approve large redemptions.

6. GoldBod

Responsible for:

Gold supply
Gold verification
Gold custody records
7. Regulators

Including:

SEC Ghana
Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC)
NPRA

They receive compliance reports automatically.

What does an investor experience?

A customer journey looks like this:

Download the MySikaGold app.
Register an account.
Verify identity using Ghana Card and SmileID.
Set up a PIN.
Choose a gold fund.
View today's live gold price (NAV).
Deposit money using MoMo or GhanaPay.
Purchase fractional gold.
Receive confirmation and a digital receipt.
Watch the investment grow over time.
Receive monthly statements.
Later sell or redeem gold when those features are enabled.
Phase 1 (Pilot)

The Phase 1 Prompt Pack builds the first working version for approximately the first 1,000 investors. It includes:

Mobile app
Investor registration
Login
PIN authentication
Identity verification
Live gold pricing
Investor dashboard
MoMo payments
GhanaPay payments
Receipt generation
NAV calculation engine
Backend APIs
PostgreSQL database
Deployment on PAIX Accra infrastructure

At the end of Phase 1, a real investor should be able to register, verify identity, see live gold prices, and buy gold through the mobile app.

Phase 2 (Production)

Phase 2 transforms the pilot into a fully commercial platform by adding:

Flutterwave
PAPSS
GhIPSS D

I am seeking an experienced biostatistician or diagnostic test accuracy meta-analysis specialist to produce a confidential, publication-quality statistical figures and summary outputs for a postgraduate biomedical science thesis.

The research examines the diagnostic accuracy of artificial intelligence methods used to detect malaria from peripheral blood films. A completed Excel spreadsheet will be provided containing the extracted study characteristics and diagnostic accuracy data.

3. Generate separate coupled forest plots for sensitivity and specificity for each relevant subgroup.

4. Generate SROC or HSROC plots showing:
study-level estimates
pooled operating point
95% confidence region
prediction region

5. Provide pooled sensitivity and specificity with 95% confidence intervals.
Provide positive and negative likelihood ratios and diagnostic odds ratios where appropriate.

6.Report relevant measures of between-study heterogeneity.

jobs.title: Female Shopify Designer for Fashion
jobs.description:
My women’s clothing label is ready for its online debut and I want a bold, vibrant Shopify store that converts visitors into buyers. The site’s main purpose is simple: sell products online. To achieve that, I need an experienced female Shopify designer who can translate my brand’s colourful, fashion-forward aesthetic into a seamless shopping experience.

Scope of work  
• Custom theme or heavily customised premium theme that instantly communicates a lively, confident style.  
• Core pages: Home, Product Listing (collection), About Us, and Contact Us. Each page should keep visual energy high while making navigation effortless.  
• Mobile-first layouts, fast load times, intuitive cart and checkout flow, and integration of multiple payment gateways.  
• Basic SEO settings, shipping profiles, and automated order notifications configured so I can go live the moment the design is approved.  
• Style guide delivered at hand-off so future updates stay on brand.  
• Optional but welcomed: guidance on lookbook sections, size chart displays, and Instagram feed integration if that helps elevate the shop’s vibe.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Design matches the “bold and vibrant” direction with consistent typography, colour palette, and imagery.  
2. Store is fully responsive and passes Shopify’s theme check without errors.  
3. Products can be added, edited, and purchased end-to-end using standard Shopify workflows.  
4. All four pages are populated with placeholder copy and imagery that I can update easily.  
5. A brief recorded walkthrough or written SOP shows me how to maintain the store after launch.

If this aligns with your expertise and you have a portfolio that proves it, let’s make this fashion site pop.

jobs.title: CodeSYS Programming for HED 713 Display
jobs.description:
I need a complete CodeSYS application built for an HED 713 display that will act as the front-end controller for a generator. The project covers everything from hardware I/O mapping to a finished user interface and fault-tolerant logic.

Interface requirements  
• Design a single, intuitive screen that shows live status indicators and custom graphics.  
• Incorporate on-screen Start/Stop, Reset, and Menu navigation buttons.  
• Allow the operator to drill down into engine and generator metrics pulled from CAN.

Network integration  
Two separate CAN buses must be managed. One will stream engine parameters; the other carries generator status and electrical load data. The program needs to read, display, and where appropriate act on that information (alarms, shutdowns, load shedding, etc.).

Control logic  
Write all PLC logic necessary to start, stop, and protect the genset, handle input/output interlocks, and manage fail-safe states. Electrical knowledge is essential so that trips, sensor scaling, and safety chains are implemented correctly.

Deliverables  
1. Compiled CodeSYS project file for the HED 713  
2. All graphic assets and symbol libraries used  
3. Basic operating manual or inline comments explaining configuration steps  

Please include a sample of previous CodeSYS or HED work when you respond. I will pay hourly and agree final terms once I’ve reviewed your past projects and am confident you can meet the scope.

jobs.title: Chauffeur Service Website Development
jobs.description:

• Home  
• Booking  
• About Us  

The Booking page has to support an online payment system (Stripe or PayPal are fine) and must automatically send a confirmation email to the client once a reservation is completed. If you can leave room in the codebase for a future real-time availability checker that would be helpful, though it isn’t required right now.

Please handle the full front-end and back-end setup—responsive design, SEO-friendly structure, and a simple CMS or well-commented files so I can update fleet details and pricing on my own. Once everything is live and tested, hand over the source files and any credentials.

jobs.title: Book Cover Design – The Rooms We Built
jobs.description:
Cover Design Brief – The Rooms We Built

(Final — with inside covers)

---

1. Book Information

Title: The Rooms We Built
Subtitle: An ever‑ending road of moments
Author Name: Bob Cassens 
Genre: Memoir / Wellness / Philosophy
Trim Size: 5.5" x 8.5"
Page Count: ~86 pages (with blank pages for reflection)

---

2. Base Color

A warm, muted slate gray flows continuously from the front cover, across the spine, to the back cover. It should feel deep enough to be quiet, light enough to feel open — not black, but with a subtle warmth that invites the reader in.

---

3. Inside Covers

Front and back inside covers are left blank and printed in the same warm slate gray as the cover. This creates a seamless transition from the outside of the book to the interior. The reader opens the book and enters the same quiet space before the text begins.

---

4. Front Cover

Image: A dark hallway running diagonally from the bottom left corner toward the top right. At the top right, a single door is slightly ajar, with a sliver of warm light spilling through. The hallway should feel spacious, still, and quiet — not claustrophobic.

Mood: Quiet, calm, mysterious. The door is not closed. It is not locked. It is waiting.

Text:

· Title: The Rooms We Built — centered, in a clean serif font (Garamond, Caslon, or similar)
· Subtitle: An ever‑ending road of moments — smaller, centered beneath the title
· Author name: Bob — centered beneath the subtitle

Typography: Clean, classic serif. Title and author name centered, overlapping the hallway image. The title should remain readable against the image — a subtle dark overlay or shadow may be used.

---

5. Back Cover

Image: A winding road that begins at the bottom left and curves gently upward toward the top right, receding into mist. No car, no figure, no destination visible.

Text: Placed in the upper left area, off the road, centered and in paragraph form, with generous white space around it:

"The Rooms We Built is a quiet, honest book about perception, presence, and the spaces we carry with us."

No other text on the back cover. No author bio. No barcode. No review quotes.

---

6. Spine

· Clean, centered, understated
· Background color matching the front cover (warm slate gray)
· Title: THE ROOMS WE BUILT — reading top to bottom
· Author: BOB — centered beneath the title
· Font matching the front cover

---

7. What the Designer Should Know

· The book is a collection of moments, not a linear story
· It is built on white space, perception, and quiet reflection
· The cover should feel like a room you're not sure you've entered before
· No people. No faces. No clever typography
· The tone is honest, generous, and still
· The front and back covers are a visual conversation: straight hallway (front) vs. winding road (back) — a journey inward and a journey outward
· The inside covers are blank but in the same warm slate gray to extend the atmosphere

---

8. Deliverables

· Print‑ready PDF (for the printer)
· Digital fil

You’ll be working on a single document of roughly bedtime-story length—Episode 1 only. I’d like tracked-changes with inline comments plus a clean copy ready for layout, along with a short editorial note summarizing any larger-scale suggestions.  

Let me know if you’re currently open to children’s projects of this size, your typical turnaround for a manuscript like this, and your rate structure. If you’ve shepherded other picture-or early-reader books through this exact text-on-left / art-on-right format, please mention it—I’m keen to collaborate with someone who understands page-turn suspense and read-aloud flow.  

I’m looking forward to hearing how you’d polish Bubba’s first adventure.

jobs.title: Toddler Storybook on Diaper Life
jobs.description:

My goal is to give young children reassuring, age-appropriate language about potty readiness, hygiene, and family routines, all wrapped in a warm narrative that honours mum’s effort without ever sounding preachy.

Here’s what I’m after: a complete, engaging manuscript of roughly 800–1,200 words, broken into easy-to-read spreads that lend themselves naturally to full-page illustrations. The text should feature a relatable toddler protagonist, supportive mum, and simple plot points (morning change, playtime adventures, grocery trip, bedtime) that weave gentle lessons about responsibility and love. Humour is welcome in small doses, but the overarching tone must remain clearly educational.

What you’ll deliver  
• Final story text, formatted by spreads (e.g., “Spread 1 – left page / right page”)  
• Short illustration notes per spread—nothing too prescriptive, just guidance for an artist later on  
• A brief paragraph explaining the key educational takeaways for parents

Ideal background  
Children’s writers with previous 2-4 year old titles or educators who understand early childhood language development. Familiarity with inclusive family depictions and potty-training milestones is a plus.

I will provide prompt feedback on outlines and drafts, aiming for a smooth, collaborative process and a polished, print-ready manuscript.

jobs.title: Residential Pool & Spa Hydraulic Design -- 2
jobs.description:
Residential Infinity Pool and 4-Person Hot Spa Hydraulic and Mechanical Design

We are looking for an experienced swimming pool mechanical, plumbing, or hydraulic engineer to prepare a complete fluid mechanical design for a residential infinity-edge swimming pool with an integrated or adjacent heated spa for approximately four people.

Project Overview

The project is located in California, USA and includes:

>Residential infinity-edge swimming pool
>Approximate pool size: 40 ft × 10 ft
>Heated square spa for approximately four adults
>Preliminary spa size: approximately 7 ft × 7 ft, subject to final design
>Infinity-edge catch basin or surge tank
>Dedicated pool mechanical equipment room
>Pool and spa filtration, circulation, heating, sanitation, drainage, and automatic control systems
>Slat pool cover 

Architectural drawings, pool layout, elevations, site information, and the proposed mechanical-room location will be provided to the selected freelancer.

Scope of Work

The selected engineer or designer will be responsible for preparing a complete hydraulic and mechanical design, including the following:

1. Calculate the required pool and spa circulation flow rates.
2. Determine appropriate turnover rates based on applicable residential pool standards and local requirements.
3. Design the swimming pool circulation and filtration system.
4. Design the infinity-edge overflow system, catch basin, and surge tank system.
5. Calculate the required catch-basin or surge-tank capacity.
6. Size all piping, including:
>Pool suction piping
>Pool return piping
>Main drains
>Skimmer piping
>Infinity-edge overflow piping
>Catch-basin piping
>Spa suction and return piping
>Spa jet piping
>Spa air piping
>Fill-water piping
>Drain and waste piping
> Filter backwash piping, if applicable

7. Calculate total dynamic head, pressure losses, pipe velocities, and pump operating points.
8. Select and size the following equipment:
>Pool circulation pump
>Infinity-edge or catch-basin pump
>Spa circulation pump
>Spa hydrotherapy jet pump
>Spa air blower
>Pool and spa filters
>Pool heater
>Spa heater
>Sanitization equipment
>Chemical-treatment equipment
>Automation and control equipment
>Valves, check valves, unions, flow meters, and associated accessories

9. Design the four-person heated spa, including:

>Recommended finished internal dimensions
>Water depth
>Seating height and bench layout
>Approximate water volume
>Number and location of hydrotherapy jets
>Jet flow rate and pressure requirements
>Dedicated jet-pump sizing
>Air-blower sizing
>Suction fitting locations
>Return fitting locations
>Drain and overflow provisions
>Heater capacity
>Required heat-up time
>Operating temperature controls
>Spa insulation recommendations

10. Design separate operating modes for:

jobs.title: Workflow Automation Development - PHP/MySQL & Claude Code Specialist
jobs.description:
Position: Senior PHP/MySQL Engineer (Claude Code Specialist) - Workflow Automation Platform, Long Term

We are a U.S. professional services firm building an internal workflow automation platform to replace a licensed third-party system. This is a long-term engagement, six months or more, for one senior engineer.

WHAT EXISTS
We have a design skeleton, not a finished system:
  - A draft MySQL 8 schema (definition/runtime separation, RBAC, audit tables)
  - A prototype workflow engine validated against a real workflow definition
  - An importer that normalizes an existing workflow export of ~290 activities and ~5,000 tasks
  - Skeleton auth, audit logging, and cron scaffolding

This has not been run in a live environment and is not a vetted production architecture. We expect you to review it critically and tell us where it is wrong before you build on it. Candidates who accept it uncritically are not what we are looking for.

THE STACK
  - PHP 8.1+, zero third party dependencies (PDO, openssl, password_* only; no Composer, no framework)
  - MySQL 8 on AWS (Linux)
  - Server rendered PHP with light vanilla JS. No SPA framework.
  - Must work across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge
  - Cron driven background processing

THE CORE PROBLEM
A configurable workflow engine. A workflow is a template of approximately 290 activities, each gated by conditions: data comparisons, checklist selections, and task predecessors. The engine evaluates each case's data and instantiates only the activities whose triggers fire. The engine is domain agnostic, so additional workflows are data rather than code. Work routes to queues with load balanced distribution across approximately 20+ users. The system handles deadline ticklers, confirmable dates, and hold and close behavior.

AI ARCHITECTURE
A two-tier design. You must be comfortable with both:
  - Local tier: a dedicated Mac server running Ollama, handling high volume, routine, and privacy sensitive work including document assembly from templates, field extraction, classification, and summarization. Zero marginal cost, and data does not leave our infrastructure.
  - Cloud tier: the Anthropic Claude API for work requiring higher level reasoning.
You will build a routing and abstraction layer that selects the tier based on task type and data sensitivity, so either tier can be replaced without touching calling code. Every AI generated document must pass a human approval gate before finalization. This requirement is not negotiable.

REPORTING
The platform exchanges data in both directions with a third-party financial model maintained outside the system. Egress: stable star schema views over the transactional tables, exposed through a least privilege read only account. Ingress: a validated import path for external financial data, staged into dedicated tables, with schema validation, rejection handling, and a load log. Each data element has a single system of record and neither side overwrites the other's authoritative data

jobs.title: Hyper-Realistic Face Swap Retouch
jobs.description:
I have two photos ready for you:  

• Image 1 – the original Instagram shot that must stay untouched except for the head.  
• Image 2 – a selfie of the person whose face needs to appear in Image 1.

Your task is to replace only the head/face in Image 1 with the face from Image 2 while leaving every other pixel exactly as it is. Clothing, hairline edge, background, grain, color grading—everything must remain identical so the final composite looks like it was captured that way in-camera.

I expect an almost forensic level of realism: perfect skin-tone transitions, matching light direction and intensity, correct lens distortion, and zero proportion changes. AI tools (FaceFusion, Stable Diffusion, etc.) are welcome for texture synthesis, but I need meticulous Photoshop cleanup so the swap is completely undetectable even when overlaid at 100 % opacity.

Deliverables  
• High-resolution flattened JPEG in the same dimensions and color profile as Image 1  
• A layered PSD showing your key adjustment layers and masks for potential tweaks  

Acceptance Criteria  
1. Side-by-side comparison shows no halo, blur, or color shift around the replaced area.  
2. A 100 % zoom overlay reveals pixel-level alignment with the original features (jawline, ears, neck).  
3. File passes basic error-level analysis without obvious manipulation artifacts.  

Send the finished files along with a brief note on the AI workflow you used so I can replicate the look on future shots. Two quick revision rounds are included to nail any micro-adjustments.

jobs.title: Refurbished MOCVD Reactor Setup
jobs.description:
The task is to take a fully-refurbished G3 MOCVD reactor that is already on site and bring it into full operational service inside my industrial facility. Mechanical placement, alignment, and anchoring are complete; the remaining work centres on integration, commissioning, and validation.

Integration requirements  
• Tie the reactor into the existing high-purity gas delivery cabinet (H₂, NH₃, group-III precursors) without disturbing live lines.  
• Connect to our dedicated 3-phase 480 V electrical feed and verify all interlocks, earths, and breakers.  
• Interface cooling-water, exhaust, and scrubber ducts to match current plant standards.

Commissioning & acceptance  
• Run leak checks (helium mass-spec) on every new joint.  
• Calibrate MFCs, pressure gauges, and thermocouples; confirm temperature uniformity across the susceptor.  
• Execute a dry-run recipe followed by a GaN epitaxy test wafer. Stable growth rate within ±3 % and background pressure <1 × 10⁻⁵ Torr will mark acceptance.  
• Deliver a concise hand-over report containing wiring diagrams, gas hookup schematics, safety certificates, and the final process log.

Tools on hand: AIXTRON service kit, helium leak detector, Fluke ScopeMeter, and complete OEM manuals. Feel free to bring any additional specialty gauges or alignment fixtures you prefer; floor space, crane access, and cleanroom garments are provided.

Timeline is flexible within the next sixteen weeks, but once work begins I would like commissioning wrapped up inside five consecutive days to minimise downtime on adjoining tools.

jobs.title: Children’s Storybook Creator App
jobs.description:
I want a single, polished mobile application—running natively on both iOS and Android—that lets any parent, teacher, or budding author craft a complete children’s storybook from blank page to published title. Inside the app the user begins with a script-writing workspace that supports chapter organization, simple formatting controls, and AI-assisted wording suggestions (if you prefer an off-the-shelf library for this, let me know).  

From there, illustration is the star feature. I need advanced editing tools: multi-layer drawing, adjustable brushes, text overlays, filters, and the ability to import or export high-resolution PNGs so artists can refine images externally if they wish. Think Procreate-lite capabilities, not just a basic doodle pad.  

When the story is ready, the user should tap “Publish” and choose among industry-standard formats:  
• PDF  
• ePub  
• MOBI  

The export pipeline must preserve image quality, embed fonts correctly, and attach metadata that meets Amazon KDP’s current requirements so the file is accepted without further tweaks. A guided upload flow or direct KDP integration would be ideal, but at minimum the app must generate compliant files the user can drop straight into Amazon.  

Deliverables  
1. Production-ready iOS and Android builds plus source code (React Native, Flutter, Swift/Kotlin—your call, as long as performance is smooth).  
2. Admin-side documentation covering build steps, third-party SDKs, and how to update illustration assets.  
3. A brief user guide or walkthrough video that shows writing, illustrating, and exporting a book in all three formats.  

I’ll test final binaries on both platforms; acceptance is when I can create a short picture book, export it to PDF, ePub, and MOBI, and upload those files to my Amazon KDP dashboard without validation errors.

jobs.title: Copywriting
jobs.description:
*~*Cybersecurity*~*

**• Introduction:**

* We use the internet or applications daily for selling or buying, doing business, playing games, online earning, and other activities, but sometimes this information is hacked by malicious attackers. After hacking, they misuse our information or use it wrongly.

**• Definition:**

* Cybersecurity is combined with two words: Cyber and Security.
* Cyber means related to the internet, computers, data, information, technology, networks, applications, etc.
* Security means protecting and keeping things safe from harm, such as protecting information from hackers.
* It means cybersecurity is the practice of protecting software, hardware, the internet, networks, computers, programs, data, information, and other applications from unauthorized access, harm, hackers, cybercriminals, malicious attacks, the dark web, and pornographic websites.

**• Types of Cyber Attacks:**

* **1) Malware**

  * It is harmful software, such as computer viruses, that causes damage.

* **2) Adware**

  * It is software that displays ads on your device.

* **3) Trojan Horse**

  * It is a type of malware that steals passwords and breaks into systems.

* **4) Ransomware**

  * It is an attack that blocks people's computers or systems.
  * Then the hackers demand money to unblock them.

* **5) Phishing Emails**

  * Fake emails are sent to you to steal your login details.
  * They trick users into sharing personal information.

**• Advantages of Cybersecurity:**

* **1) Data Protection**

  * It protects files, documents, emails, etc., from unauthorized access.

* **2) Business Continuity**

  * It helps keep business operations running during disruptions.

* **3) Reputational Safeguard**

  * It is a strategy used to protect the reputation of a person or organization.

* **4) Prevention of Financial Fraud**

  * It helps protect money and financial information from fraudulent websites and scams.

* **5) Economic Stability**

  * It helps protect online buying and selling activities from cyber threats.

I’ve written a light-hearted comedy skit and now I want to see it on screen without spending weeks in production software. My goal is to have an AI-driven workflow that turns my finished script—and the specific character images I’ll provide—into a fully rendered short film.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A playable HD video matching the script line-for-line.  
2. Characters on screen resemble the visual references I supply.  
3. Dialogue is synchronized with lip movement or appropriate cinematic cuts.  
4. Source project files or reproducible pipeline instructions so I can generate future episodes from new scripts.

If you’ve already built similar AI video generators or have a solid demo, I’d love to see it. Let’s bring this skit to life.

Playwright-based Web Automation Remote User Interaction
jobs.description:
Description:

I have a fully functional Playwright-based web automation system that needs one final piece to go live in production: enabling end users to view and interact with the Playwright-controlled browser remotely through a web interface.

Tech Stack:

Node.js
Playwright
Prisma ORM
MySQL
PM2
Nginx

Current Status (Working):

The application runs perfectly in local development with headless: false — login automation, search automation, form interactions, navigation monitoring, data extraction, database operations, and push notifications all work correctly.
Full VPS deployment is complete: server configured (Ubuntu, Node.js, Chrome, Playwright, MySQL, Prisma), database connected via Prisma, the Node app runs on port 3000, PM2 manages the process with auto-restart, and Nginx reverse proxy is set up and working.
We resolved the "Missing X server / $DISPLAY" issue using Xvfb — Chrome launches successfully in a virtual display, and PM2 logs confirm the browser opens and pages load correctly under Xvfb.

The Problem:
Because the VPS has no physical display, Chrome runs inside a headless/virtual (Xvfb) session. The automation itself works, but end users cannot see or interact with the browser — the session isn't exposed anywhere.

What I Need Built:
Implement a browser streaming solution so users can view and interact with the same live browser instance that Playwright is controlling, without breaking the existing automation logic. Recommended approach (open to alternatives):

XFCE Desktop (already installed) + TigerVNC
noVNC for browser-based streaming access
WebSocket proxy configuration
Nginx integration + HTTPS
Launch Chrome inside the streamed desktop session so Playwright and the user share the same browser instance

Deliverables:

Working noVNC/TigerVNC + XFCE setup on our VPS, streaming the live browser to users via web browser
Nginx + WebSocket + HTTPS configuration for secure remote access
Verified that Playwright continues to monitor/control the same browser session users are viewing
Documentation of the setup and configuration
(Nice to have) Guidance or setup for future scaling: per-user session isolation, timeout/cleanup handling, multi-user support

jobs.description:
build an end-to-end NFC-Based Spare Parts & Asset Tracking System. The solution consists of a Cross-Platform Mobile App (Android/iOS) for field and warehouse operations, and a Web-Based Management Dashboard for real-time inventory and device tracking.

The primary goal of the system is to track high-value spare parts from the warehouse to field technicians, monitor their installation on specific medical/technical equipment, and trace any returns back to the warehouse.

System Architecture & Tech Stack Expectations
Mobile App: Flutter or React Native (Must support native NFC scanning on both Android and iOS).

Backend: Node.js (Express/NestJS), Python (FastAPI), or C# (.NET Core) with RESTful APIs.

Database: PostgreSQL or MySQL (Relational database structure with robust state-machine tracking).

Web Dashboard: React.js, Vue.js, or Next.js.

Core Workflows & Key Features
1. Warehouse Dispatch (Warehouse Staff)
Scan NFC tag on a spare part box using the mobile app.

Retrieve part details automatically via API.

Select the target Field Technician and target Medical Device/Equipment from dropdowns/search.

Update status to DISPATCHED.

2. Field Receipt & Installation (Field Technician)
Field technician receives the physical part and scans the NFC tag.

Confirms receipt → Status updates to RECEIVED_IN_FIELD.

Options to either:

Mount to Device: Tag assigned to the equipment → Status updates to INSTALLED_ON_DEVICE.

Return to Warehouse: Initiate return process → Status updates to RETURN_IN_TRANSIT.

3. Web Management Dashboard (Admins & Managers)
Live Inventory Tracking: Real-time status of all parts (In Warehouse, In Transit, Installed on Device, Returned).

Equipment-Centric View: Search a specific medical device/serial number to see all spare parts currently installed or historically replaced on it.

User & Asset Management: CRUD operations for Parts, Devices, Technicians, and Warehouses.

Audit Trail & Reports: Detailed transaction log (Who scanned what, when, and where). Export functionality (PDF / Excel).

NFC & Hardware Requirements
The mobile app must read standard NTAG213 / NTAG215 NFC chips .

NFC tags will hold a unique Hardware UID or encoded UUID (e.g., PRC-847291), which maps to the backend database record.

Key Deliverables
Source Code: Fully documented and clean repository (GitHub / GitLab).

Mobile App Builds: Working APK (Android) and TestFlight / IPA (iOS).

Web Dashboard: Deployed web admin portal.

API Documentation: OpenAPI / Postman collection for all endpoints.

Database Schema: Well-documented SQL migration scripts.

Developer Requirements / Qualifications
Proven experience with NFC integration in mobile apps (Flutter nfc_manager or React Native NFC libraries).

Strong background in building inventory management or asset tracking solutions.

Ability to design clean UI/UX for both mobile and web interfaces.

Clear communication and regular progress updates.

Examples of previous NFC, RFID, or As

jobs.title: Multimodal Gene Text Disease Prediction
jobs.description:
I’m building a deep-learning system that can look at two very different kinds of information—gene-level data and free-form clinical text—and fuse them to predict whether a patient is likely to develop a target disease. The heart of the job is a multimodal architecture that treats gene features and textual features as complementary signals, learns their joint representation, and outputs a binary (disease / no-disease) or probabilistic risk score.

Here is what I need from you. First, a clean data-pipeline that ingests my gene expression matrices alongside the associated clinical notes, handles any necessary tokenisation or normalisation, and keeps sample alignment intact. Second, a well-documented model—PyTorch or TensorFlow is fine—that includes separate encoders for each modality and a fusion layer able to capture cross-modal interactions before the final prediction head. Finally, solid training and evaluation scripts with clear metrics such as AUC, accuracy, precision-recall and, ideally, an ablation option so we can see the added value of each modality.

Deliverables  
• Python source code (model, training, inference)  
• A runnable notebook or script that reproduces the main results on my sample dataset  
• README explaining environment setup, data expectations and how to fine-tune or extend the model  
• Short report summarising performance and any hyper-parameters chosen

Acceptance criteria  
• Model trains without errors on the provided dataset  
• Fusion variant beats single-modality baselines by a statistically meaningful margin  
• Reproducible metrics and clear, commented code

If you are comfortable working with multimodal deep learning, NLP preprocessing, and bioinformatics-style gene features, I’d love to see how you would approach this.

Tell me briefly about similar Android apps you’ve shipped, your preferred tech stack, and an estimated timeline. I’m ready to get started as soon as we align on approach and milestones.

jobs.title: NVIDIA AI Control PCBA Design
jobs.description:
I need a lead-level hardware systems engineer who is comfortable building around NVIDIA AI modules and can take my concept all the way from schematic to assembled boards. The core task is to design, fabricate, and bring-up custom PCBAs that drive a control system while cleanly interfacing with three sensor classes—temperature sensors, motion detectors, and cameras.

Form factor, power budget, and component selection all matter in this build; I already have target size dimensions, allowable power envelope, and a shortlist of preferred parts that we will refine together. Once we lock the architecture you will prepare the complete design package, handle a short prototype run, and validate the hardware with the sensors hooked up.

Deliverables  
• Schematics and PCB layout files  
• Manufacturing outputs (Gerber, drill, pick-and-place, tested BOM)  
• Assembled and first-article-tested boards  
• Sensor integration report confirming stable operation with temperature, motion, and camera inputs  
• Clear build notes and a brief hand-off document so my internal team can start firmware development immediately

Acceptance is based on the prototype boards powering up cleanly, meeting the agreed mechanical envelope, staying within the specified power draw, and correctly driving all three sensor types without signal integrity issues.

If you live and breathe NVIDIA-centric hardware design and have shipped control-oriented boards before, I’m ready to get started.

jobs.title: Microsoft Email Migration, Apollo Integration & Domain
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Brand Launch E-Commerce Website
jobs.description:
I’m preparing to unveil a new brand and need a single, polished website that can sell everything I offer on day one. The site’s primary role is E-commerce, but it also has to present my professional services clearly. Here’s the mix you’ll be building for:

• Consulting  
• Training  

Products to sell: street-style clothing, virtual seminar seats, downloadable ebooks, and paperback editions. That means the store must process physical shipments, issue instant digital downloads, and handle event ticketing/registration from the same checkout.

What I expect from the build  
• A responsive, modern design that reflects the brand (logo, colors, and fonts supplied).  
• Unified catalog with variants, stock control, secure checkout (card, PayPal; Apple/Google Pay welcome).  
• Automated file delivery for ebooks and unique access links for each seminar purchase.  
• Shipping rules for clothing and paperbacks.  
• Dedicated service pages so clients can review Consulting and Training packages and request bookings.  
• Easy-to-use CMS so I can add new products, edit copy, and post updates without touching code.  
• On-page SEO basics and Google Analytics integration.

Deliverables  
1. Fully developed, tested, and deployed website on my hosting or the chosen platform (Shopify or WooCommerce preferred, but I’m open to alternatives if they cover every feature).  
2. Admin walkthrough or short video so I know how to fulfil orders, add products, and manage content.  
3. Two weeks of post-launch support for any critical fixes.

If you’ve built multi-product stores with both physical and digital goods—or integrated service bookings—please share links and outline your timeline. I’m ready to move quickly once we agree on the stack and workflow.

jobs.title: Mobile Application with Advanced AI Integration
jobs.description:
AI-Powered Mobile App Development

I am looking for an experienced mobile app developer to build a modern, fast, and user-friendly AI-powered mobile application. The app should have a clean and responsive UI, excellent performance, and work smoothly on both Android and iOS.

The developer should be experienced with AI integration, mobile app development, secure authentication, cloud databases, and scalable architecture. The app should include user accounts, real-time features, notifications, and a professional design that is easy to navigate.

Please include examples of similar projects you have completed, your recommended technology stack, estimated timeline, and any suggestions that could improve the app. I am looking for a long-term collaboration with a developer who communicates well and delivers high-quality work on time.

jobs.title: Financial Dashboard Redesign with Excel Integration
jobs.description:
I'm looking for an experienced developer to modify my financial performance dashboard, which is built in HTML and currently loads data from Excel.

- Experience in dashboard development and modification

Please provide samples of similar work done.

jobs.title: AI-Driven Customer Support Platform Development

jobs.title: PHOTOBOOK
jobs.description:
Saya sedang memulai “proyekk baguss” dan membutuhkan sebuah logo bergaya modern yang mampu tampil bersih, tegas, dan mudah diingat. Silakan bereksperimen dengan warna, tipografi, dan bentuk selama hasil akhir tetap terasa segar serta relevan bagi audiens digital masa kini.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Christian Youth Prayer Drama
jobs.description:
I have a children’s sermon that speaks about what it means to be a truly prayerful child, and I’d like it transformed into a short video drama that will captivate an audience ranging from 7- to 19-year-olds. I’m aiming for a finished piece that runs between 10 and 30 minutes, carries an unmistakably inspirational tone, and leaves everyone—kids, teens, and the adults in the room—wanting to talk more about how prayer can become part of everyday life.

You will receive the raw sermon transcript along with a dramatized drama for the sermon. Your task is to turn the written drama into a very inspiring and captivating video using AI tools.  Humor may appear organically in the drama, but the overall mood should remain hope-filled and motivating rather than purely comedic.

Deliverables  
• Final video and script running 10–30 minutes 

I’m happy to answer questions about theological emphasis or practical constraints before you begin. If this sounds like your creative wheelhouse, I look forward to seeing how you can bring the message alive on stage.

jobs.title: Romantic Unrequited Love Poems
jobs.description:
I need a small collection of original love poems that feel deeply romantic and passionate while capturing the quiet ache of unrequited affection. Each piece should weave in nature imagery—think flowers opening at dusk, sun-washed horizons, or a fading sunset—so the emotions become vivid and tactile.

Scope of work
• 8–10 poems, 12–24 lines each, written in contemporary free verse or light, unobtrusive rhyme.  
• A consistent yet flexible voice across the set; every poem should also stand on its own.  
• Language must stay honest and relatable, avoiding overused clichés.  
• Deliver everything in a single, well-formatted document (DOCX or Google Doc) plus a plain-text copy.

Process & timeline
I’ll review the first two poems soon after delivery and share notes. Plan on one revision round for the full set.  
First full draft is expected within one week of project start; final, polished work within three days of my feedback.

Quality requirements
• All poems must be entirely original and unpublished.  
• No AI-generated or plagiarized content; I will perform checks.  
• Proper grammar, spelling, and formatting throughout.

Once approved, I will hold full rights to the completed poems.

jobs.title: Research-Based Nutrition Blog Writer
jobs.description:
I’m building out a Health & Wellness site and need a steady flow of evidence-driven articles that zero in on nutrition and diet. Each piece should read smoothly for a general audience yet be rooted in current peer-reviewed studies, reputable journals, and official guidelines (think PubMed, WHO, NIH, etc.).

Here’s what I’d like to receive for every article:
• 1,200-1,500 words of original copy  
• Clear in-text citations with a reference list  
• SEO-ready structure: engaging H1/H2 headings, meta title (≤60 chars) & meta description (≤160 chars)  
• A concise key-takeaways box for quick readers  
• Two royalty-free image suggestions with captions

Acceptance criteria  
• Factual accuracy backed by up-to-date research (published within the last 5 years whenever possible)  
• Zero AI-generated or spun content—everything must pass plagiarism checks  
• Tone: friendly, empowering, never preachy; jargon explained in plain language  
• Delivered in Google Docs with editing rights enabled

If you can consistently turn complex nutritional science into approachable, actionable reading, I’d love to start with one article and expand into an ongoing series.

jobs.title: AI-Driven Long-Tail Keyword Research
jobs.description:
I’m kicking off an AI-powered SEO initiative and need a data-rich study focused strictly on keyword analysis. The spotlight is on long-tail phrases that can realistically lift my organic traffic.  

Here’s what I need from you:  
• Mine long-tail opportunities with clear intent using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Keyword Planner, or your preferred AI-assisted workflow.  
• Deliver a ranked list that includes search volume, keyword difficulty, SERP features, and traffic potential so I can see where the quickest wins lie.  
• Group results by topical relevance and buying stage, highlighting gaps where new content could outrank current competitors.  
• Conclude with a brief action plan explaining which clusters to target first and why.  

A concise spreadsheet (CSV or Google Sheets) plus a short summary document will be perfect. If you have an automated method for refreshing the data periodically, let me know—that would be a bonus.

jobs.title: Classic Slot Machine Development
jobs.description:
I'm looking for a skilled game developer to create classic slot machine games. The games can feature any theme or style, including:

jobs.title: Social Buzz for Comics & Novels
jobs.description:
I’ve just started releasing **Meridian Network**, an original science-fantasy comic series with companion fiction set in the same universe. It blends ancient portal networks, buried wartime technology, field engineering, strange archaeology, and a team held together by competence, friction, and the occasional terrible decision.

Now I need help putting it in front of the readers who already enjoy stories like this.

The work will focus on Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube Shorts, and any other platform where you already understand the audience and have genuine reach. I am not looking for identical posts sprayed across six channels. Each platform needs material shaped for how people actually use it.

The job includes:

* Planning and publishing daily or near-daily campaign content built around comic panels, short scene clips, character moments, lore fragments, behind-the-scenes material, and release hooks.
* Finding relevant communities without barging into them like an advertising truck.
* Building relationships with reviewers, book creators, comic accounts, science-fiction channels, indie authors, artists, and adjacent creators.
* Arranging cross-promotions, influencer features, review copies, and selective sponsored posts where the audience fit is strong.
* Tracking views, follows, click-throughs, subscriptions, and paid conversions, then adjusting the campaign around what produces actual readers rather than decorative engagement.
* Reporting results in a simple form: what we posted, where it went, what moved, and what we should test next.

The strongest audience overlap is likely to include:

* science fiction and portal fiction
* paranormal archaeology and occult technology
* indie comics and graphic novels
* character-driven speculative fiction
* webcomics, manga, animation, and AI-assisted visual production
* readers who enjoy *Stargate*-style discovery, strange machinery, lost systems, and capable teams solving impossible problems

This will begin as an hourly role with a lean starting budget while the readership and book income are still growing. As the campaign begins producing measurable sales and subscriptions, both the workload and compensation can expand.

Please include evidence of work you have already done. Portfolio links, account analytics, campaign results, audience demographics, or examples of communities you have helped grow are more useful than broad marketing promises.

In your proposal, outline how you would launch the first two weeks of **Meridian Network**:

* which platforms you would prioritise first
* what kinds of posts you would create from the existing comics and stories
* which subreddits, creator circles, reviewers, or niche communities you would approach
* how you would turn passing viewers into followers, readers, and subscribers
* what metrics you would use to decide whether the campaign is working

The goal is not one loud launch followed by silence. It is to build a recognisable world, a steady readershi

jobs.title: Photobooth Funnel & Website Build
jobs.description:
I run a growing photobooth business and I’m starting from square one with my online sales funnel. I need someone who has already built high-converting funnels for photography or event-based companies and can guide the entire process—from the first ad click all the way to a paid booking and signed contract.

The funnel must cover three core elements:
• Lead generation that attracts local event planners, brides, and corporate clients  
• Automated email follow-ups that nurture those leads until they’re ready to book  
• Sales conversion pages that make it effortless to choose a package and pay a deposit  

Alongside the funnel, I also need a streamlined website. It has to accept deposits securely, trigger an online contract for e-signature the moment payment is made, and showcase a clean gallery of past events so prospects can see what the booth looks like in action.

I’m platform-agnostic—as long as the solution is easy for me to manage later. If you’re skilled with tools such as ClickFunnels, WordPress + Elementor, Kajabi, Squarespace, or a similar stack, let me know which you recommend and why.

Deliverables I’m expecting:
1. A fully implemented funnel (ads or lead magnet entry point, email sequence, and checkout/booking page) that is live and tested.  
2. A mobile-friendly website integrated with my payment processor and e-signature provider, complete with an events gallery.  
3. Clear hand-off documentation so I can update copy, change images, and add new events without coding.  

If you can also set up basic analytics so I can track opt-in rates and conversions, that’s a plus. Please share links to at least one live funnel and one event-oriented site you’ve built so I can gauge fit.

jobs.title: WordPress Theme Design & Development

jobs.title: Budget Travel Guide Blog Writer
jobs.description:
I’m putting together a new series of travel posts aimed squarely at readers who want to see the world without burning through their savings. Each article should read like a step-by-step guide: where to stay, how to move around, the cheapest times to visit, and clever ways to cut daily costs.  

You’ll take one destination at a time and break it down into clear, actionable sections—transport, food, lodging, and must-do experiences—sprinkling in local tips that only a savvy budget traveler would know. Tone should stay friendly and encouraging, but every claim needs to be backed by current prices, reliable links, or recent first-hand data.  

Strong SEO practices are important, yet I don’t want keyword stuffing; flow and readability come first. If you work in WordPress, please format with headings (H2/H3), short paragraphs, and metadata ready to drop straight into the CMS.  

Deliverables for each post (800–1,200 words):
• Optimized title & meta description  
• Well-structured, informative guide covering the essentials for budget travelers  
• At least three outbound links to authoritative resources  
• Royalty-free images (properly attributed) or original photos if you have them  

Send a quick note with two sample travel guides you’ve written—preferably ones that target low-cost itineraries—plus a brief outline for your first proposed destination.

jobs.title: Engineering Guide Editing & Formatting
jobs.description:
I’m putting the finishing touches on an engineering operations guide, currently sitting somewhere between 10,000–50,000 words in a single Word document. The content itself is solid, but it still needs a sharp editorial eye on two fronts: 

• Minor Grammar and spelling – a light but thorough proof so every sentence reads cleanly and professionally.  
• Formatting and layout – consistent headings, figure captions, tables, page numbers, and overall styling so the manuscript looks publication-ready.

Because the file is already in Word, you can work with Track Changes for transparency, then deliver both a clean version and the marked-up file. Once those two elements feel polished, I’ll handle the final technical review internally.

If you have experience refining technical or engineering texts and enjoy smoothing out the details, I’d like to get this wrapped up quickly.

jobs.title: High-Authority SEO Backlink Outreach
jobs.description:
I need to strengthen my site’s search engine rankings by earning editorial backlinks on high-authority domains. Guest posting is the only method I want to use—no PBNs, automated directories, or comment spam. Each placement should come from a real website with solid metrics (think DA 50+ on Moz or DR 60+ on Ahrefs) and visible organic traffic, ideally in or adjacent to my niche.

You will handle the entire outreach cycle: identifying suitable targets, pitching topics, writing unique 800-1,000-word articles, and securing live do-follow links that point to the pages I specify. I’ll supply anchor text and landing URLs; everything else—from content creation to publisher fees—should be wrapped into your offer.

Deliverables  
• 90 live per month, do-follow guest-post backlinks on high-authority sites  
• A report for each link showing URL, DA/DR, estimated monthly traffic, and publication date  
• A 30-day replacement guarantee if any link is removed or switched to no-follow  

Share recent samples, outline your outreach process, and let me know how long you typically need to deliver the first and final links.

jobs.title: Recreate 150-Page Workbook PDF/Word
jobs.description:
I have photographed every page of a 150-page workbook that mixes text with illustrations, diagrams and a few tables. I now need the whole thing rebuilt from scratch so it looks clean, consistent and professional—exactly as if it had come straight from a publisher rather than my phone camera.

You will receive a folder containing the page images (JPEG/PNG). From those files, please:

• Re-typeset all text, matching fonts, headings, bullet styles and spacing as closely as possible  
• Place each illustration or diagram in the correct location, sizing and aligning so the layout mirrors the originals  
• Recreate simple graphic elements if the image quality is too poor to drop straight in (lines, boxes, arrows, etc.)  
• Keep page numbering, headers and footers uniform throughout

Deliverables  
1. A print-ready, high-resolution PDF that preserves all formatting  
2. An editable Word document (.docx) with the same layout so future revisions are easy  

I will spot-check against the originals, so accuracy and attention to detail matter more than speed. If you have experience with long-form document design in Adobe InDesign, Affinity Publisher or advanced Word layout tools, please mention it—strong styles management will make the hand-off smoother for both of us.

Let me know your estimated turnaround time and any questions you have after you see a sample set of pages.

jobs.title: Compelling Product Marketing Copy
jobs.description:
I’m launching a new line of physical products and need persuasive marketing copy that will move people from interest to purchase. Your words should spotlight key features and benefits, create a clear sense of value, and inspire immediate action—whether the copy ends up on a product page, a brochure, or a short ad.

Scope  
• Craft fresh, engaging copy focused on product promotion.  
• Keep the tone friendly yet sales-driven, matching the brand voice once I share it.  
• Emphasise tangible advantages that matter to everyday buyers.

Deliverable  
One concise, ready-to-use marketing piece that I can drop straight into my promotional material. I’ll provide product details, target audience insights, and any existing messaging; you shape it into compelling copy that converts.

If you’ve successfully sold physical goods through words before and can show it, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Expert SEO Specialist for UAE-Based Websites serving 1 local UAE Business.
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Preschool Adventure Story on Friendship
jobs.description:
I need a warm, engaging adventure story written specifically for children aged 3-5. The plot should revolve around friendship—think characters who discover, nurture, or protect a new bond while journeying through a simple, imaginative quest.   

Please craft language and pacing suitable for pre-school read-aloud sessions, with plenty of rhythmic repetition, age-appropriate vocabulary, and clear beats for page turns. Visual cues that will inspire an illustrator—describing colours, settings, or expressive actions—are welcome, but keep descriptions succinct so the text can fit comfortably on picture-book pages.  

Deliverable: a polished manuscript ready for illustration, supplied as an editable Word or Google Doc. A brief note on story structure (page or spread suggestions) will help guide layout, but the primary goal is a captivating, friendship-centred adventure that keeps the youngest readers eager for the next page.

jobs.title: Resume Redesign and cover letter
jobs.description:
My resume needs a full redesign that will sail smoothly through Applicant Tracking Systems while still looking sharp to human recruiters. The content is already written; the challenge is formatting and keyword optimization. I am targeting a small set of specific job titles, so section headers, phrasing, and keyword density have to reflect that focus without appearing stuffed or generic.

Key elements I expect:  
• Clean, parser-friendly structure with consistent heading hierarchy and minimal graphics that could trip automated screeners.  
• Strategic placement of role-specific keywords and measurable achievements so both bots and hiring managers immediately see the fit.  
• A visually balanced layout that prints well and opens flawlessly in Microsoft Word and PDF.  
• Brief guidance on why particular keywords, font choices, or layout decisions improve ATS compatibility, so I can tweak the file confidently for future roles.
Standard Cover letter based on my Resume

Deliverables:  
1. Editable Microsoft Word document.  
2. Matching PDF.  
3. One-page explanatory note outlining ATS considerations and targeted keywords.

The job will be complete once the files pass a standard online ATS scan with no formatting errors and the content reads naturally for the intended job titles.

Note: 
I am strictly looking for professionals who have Hiring experience (people with HR background) and are currently working.
Kindly share your Linkedin and other portfolio if any, when you send a chat message.

If your profile suits my requirement, i will get back to you.

jobs.title: Разместить положительный отзыв на магазин сантехники в интернете.
Minimalist Website Re-Design
jobs.description:
My current website functions well, but the visual identity no longer reflects where the brand is headed. I want a complete design refresh that feels minimalistic and clean while still being distinctive.  

Scope  
– Refresh all branding touch-points on the site: the logo, colour palette, typography, and supporting imagery/graphics must work together in one cohesive style guide.  
– Apply this new visual language to every page template so the browsing experience feels uncluttered, modern and intuitive on both desktop and mobile.  
– Optimise layouts for fast load times and straightforward navigation; I favour plenty of white space, restrained colour accents and clear, readable type.  

Deliverables  
1. Mood board and initial style exploration  
2. Finalised logo with colour specifications  
3. Typography hierarchy (web-safe fonts or licensed files)  
4. Image and graphic assets (SVG/PNG as appropriate)  
5. High-fidelity mock-ups for key pages  
6. Implemented designs on the live site or packaged files ready for hand-off, fully responsive and tested  

Acceptance criteria  
• Visuals align with the approved minimalistic concept  
• Pages render correctly on major browsers and mobile breakpoints  
• All assets supplied in editable format alongside compressed, production-ready versions  

Please build on modern standards (HTML5, CSS3, responsive frameworks or a CMS theme, depending on what suits the concept best) and keep communication open for quick iterations. I will provide current site access and any existing brand material as soon as we begin.

I need a seasoned technical-SEO professional to run a full audit of my website and carry out the resulting fixes. The audit must dig into four specific areas—performance, user experience, security and overall SEO health—so I understand exactly what is slowing the site down, where visitors may be dropping off, and which security gaps or search-visibility weaknesses still exist.

Once the report is complete, I want you to implement (or clearly document, if server access is restricted) every high-impact recommendation so the site loads faster, feels smoother to users, passes standard security checks and earns higher visibility in Google. My ultimate goals are straightforward: climb the rankings, pull in more qualified traffic and strengthen online visibility across the board.

Deliverables  
• A concise audit report outlining issues and the priority of each fix across performance, UX, security and SEO.  
• A post-implementation summary showing the improvements achieved (e.g., Core Web Vitals scores, PageSpeed insights, crawl-error reductions, resolved security flags and any keyword/visibility lifts).  
• A short, plain-English maintenance guide so I can keep the gains you deliver.

Acceptance criteria  
The site should score at least green in Google Lighthouse for both mobile and desktop, pass all basic security headers checks, and show measurable ranking or traffic uplift within a reasonable indexing window.

You are free to use your preferred toolkit—Lighthouse, GTmetrix, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, SEMrush or similar—as long as every finding is traceable and reproducible.

Our advertising effort will revolve around social media ads only; I’m not looking to branch into Google Ads or large-scale email automation just yet.  

The single metric that matters is course enrollments. Every organic post and every paid impression should ultimately contribute to growing that number. I’d like you to:  

• Plan and maintain an engaging weekly content calendar across the four platforms, tailored to each audience’s behavior and peak times.  
• Build, launch and continuously refine paid campaigns (traffic, lead and conversion objectives) with clear A/B testing and retargeting layers.  
• Monitor performance daily, then report back with concise insights—what worked, what didn’t and what you’ll adjust next.  
• Suggest low-friction funnels or landing-page tweaks if ad data shows a bottleneck.  

Access to the ad accounts, Pixel tags, and my course platform’s analytics will be provided on day one. If you already have a proven framework for turning cold social traffic into paying students, tell me briefly how you’d apply it here and the KPIs you typically hit.  

Let’s turn this course into the go-to resource in its niche—looking forward to seeing how you’d map the journey from first scroll to “Enroll now.”

jobs.title: Android E-Commerce API Development
jobs.description:
I’m building an Android-only e-commerce app and need a clean, well-documented backend API to power it. The immediate scope centres on two pillars: secure user authentication and a fully working payment gateway.

For authentication I want a modern, token-based flow with encrypted password storage, password reset and token refresh endpoints. OAuth2 or JWT is fine as long as the implementation follows OWASP recommendations and is easy to consume from an Android client (Retrofit will be used on the app side).

On payments, the API must connect to a mainstream gateway—Stripe, PayPal or a similar provider—run in sandbox first, then be production-ready. Endpoints should let the app create an order, start a transaction, receive gateway callbacks/webhooks and return a clear success or failure payload.

The product catalogue will be handled later, so focus your energy on these two modules and make the code modular enough for future expansion.

Deliverables
• REST endpoints for sign-up, login, logout and token refresh  
• Payment processing endpoints wired to the chosen gateway, fully tested with sandbox credentials  
• Environment configuration files plus a simple deployment script (Docker or similar)  
• Postman (or Swagger) collection and concise Markdown documentation covering auth flows, payment sequence and error codes  

Acceptance criteria
• All endpoints respond with standardised JSON and appropriate HTTP status codes
